sources.title: Models.dev: google/gemini-2.5-pro-preview
sources.evidence: The unsuffixed catalog key explicitly names Gemini 2.5 Pro Preview 06-05 and dates it June 5, 2025. This establishes the catalog identity being audited, not a first-party API alias or technical specification.

sources.title: Gemini API release notes
sources.evidence: June 5, 2025 explicitly releases gemini-2.5-pro-preview-06-05 with adaptive thinking. Earlier entries distinguish the March 25 experimental model, April 4 billing-enabled preview-03-25, and May 6 preview-05-06. The stable identifier launched June 17; the March and May preview IDs redirected June 26.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5: Updates to our family of thinking models (June 17, 2025)
sources.evidence: The announcement explicitly says Gemini 2.5 Pro GA has no changes from the 06-05 preview and directs preview users to gemini-2.5-pro. This is an exact-revision bridge between the June 5 preview and GA, not evidence equating earlier preview revisions. It identifies these as thinking models available through Google services. Reopened October 27, 2026: the unchanged June preview-to-GA identity is explicit, but neither version receives a numerical total or active count.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro Model Card (updated June 27, 2025)
sources.evidence: The card explicitly evaluates gemini-2.5-pro-preview-06-05 alongside separate March and May revisions. It identifies sparse MoE Transformers, multimodal inputs and text output, and thinking/coding uses. It supplies no numerical total or active production-model parameter counts. The old modelcards.withgoogle.com URL redirects to the index; this replacement PDF was downloaded and read. Fresh October 27 full-document check confirmed qualitative subset routing only; the exact 06-05 evaluation column has no parameter-size row.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5: Pushing the Frontier with Advanced Reasoning, Multimodality, Long Context, and Next Generation Agentic Capabilities
sources.evidence: Sections 2.1-2.3 describe sparse MoE Transformer architecture and training; Table 1 identifies Gemini 2.5 Pro as multimodal, dynamically thinking and tool-using. Total and per-token active parameter numbers are absent. Parameter sizes in cited papers are not Gemini sizes. The report includes evaluations through version 06-05; experimental audio-output variants do not establish audio output for this text endpoint. Fresh October 27 full-report check found no count-bearing unchanged base for this revision. The 22-billion vision-transformer and trillion-parameter Switch references are separate research models.

sources.title: Gemini API model details: indexed June 2025 page with preview versions
sources.evidence: The search-indexed former model page explicitly lists preview-06-05 and preview-05-06 under Gemini 2.5 Pro, 1,048,576 input tokens, 65,536 output tokens, audio/image/video/text/PDF inputs, text output, thinking and function calling. The complete relevant indexed section was accessible; direct navigation now redirects to the current model index. Used as last-documented historical specifications, not proof of endpoint operation.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro: Gemini API model reference
sources.evidence: The current stable-model page corroborates 1,048,576 input tokens and a separate 65,536 output limit, five supported input types, text output, thinking and function calling. Its listed model update is June 2025. Applicability to the June 5 revision is supported by the explicit unchanged-GA announcement, with historical preview documentation also checked.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Google API access is governed by service terms and restrictions, including restrictions on extracting underlying model weights. Together with the documented hosted release, this supports closed weights and a descriptive proprietary license classification; documentation and sample-code licenses are not model-weight licenses.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Pro Model Card (May 2026 edition)
sources.evidence: Inspected the later card and rendered page 5 comparison table, including the exact Gemini 2.5 Pro column. It reports benchmark results, not total or active parameter counts. The card provides no retrospective numerical count for the audited revision. Rechecked the complete current PDF and parameter-related passages October 27, 2026; no retrospective total or activated count was added.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Flash Model Card (December 17, 2025)
sources.evidence: Inspected the later card and rendered page 4 table containing a Gemini 2.5 Pro Thinking column. The table contains capability results without total or active parameter rows; it supplies no count for this model. Rechecked the complete current PDF and parameter-related passages October 27, 2026; no retrospective total or activated count was added.

sources.title: Gemini API deprecations
sources.evidence: Lists the dated 03-25, 05-06 and 06-05 Pro previews separately and records December 2, 2025 shutdown for them; 06-05 has release date June 5, 2025. It does not document the unsuffixed catalog key as a serving alias. Its conflicting March 3 date for 03-25 is not used; the contemporaneous changelog distinguishes that older revision.

sources.title: Google Transparency Report, December 2025 FMTI
sources.publisher: Google responses reproduced by Stanford CRFM; CRFM assessment
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 review of indicators 35–38. Google describes Gemini 2.5 Pro modalities and sparse MoE architecture but supplies no numerical size or explicit unchanged count-bearing base. CRFM separately notes the missing size and incomplete model dependency disclosure. The illustrative 70B example belongs to the evaluation rubric, not Gemini. Google declines to disclose benchmarked inference compute; this does not supply an active count.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon Model Card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 full decoded card check: no Gemini 2.5 Pro parameter disclosure. Argon is described as a new model, not a modification or fine-tune of a prior model; no size can be transferred backward.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon Safety & Security Report
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 full-text parameter and exact-model check. Section 6.1.3 retrospectively compares Gemini 2.5 Pro and Flash robustness, calling Flash smaller, without a numeric size. Other parameter mentions concern evaluation difficulty, security and stored knowledge; no total or activated-parameter table discloses this model size.

sources.title: Incompressible Knowledge Probes: Estimating Black-Box LLM Parameter Counts via Factual Capacity, v2
sources.evidence: Opened October 27 to examine the independent size-estimation lead. Table 2 assigns Gemini 2.5 Pro approximately 3.0T open-model-equivalent effective capacity with a 943B–9.6T prediction band. The method is explicitly a coarse black-box estimate, not a Google nominal disclosure or a measured weight count; it does not establish the exact June preview active size.

name.note: The baseline name identifies the June 5 revision. The shortened catalog key is retained as its record identity; no first-party claim is made that the unsuffixed key was a functioning Google API alias.

developer.note: Google DeepMind developed and Google distributed this Gemini model; Google is the normalized catalog developer.

family.note: Normalized Pro subfamily, consistent with the explicitly identified Gemini2.5Pro revision and the stable record.

release_date.note: Earliest release of this exact 06-05 revision was June 5. June 17 is the unchanged stable identifier release. March 25, April 4 and May 6 concern earlier revisions or their API identifiers; no alias date replaces this revision date.

open_weights.note: Released for hosted Google services under API terms, with no public checkpoint distribution in the primary release material. Closed-weight classification is supported; model-card publication is not weight publication.

license.note: Descriptive classification for a hosted Google model governed by proprietary service terms. Not the CC BY or Apache license on the documentation and examples.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 exact-model/ID count and named-base searches, reopened original evidence and later comparisons found no supported nominal total. Google explicitly identifies June 5 preview and June 17 GA as unchanged, so a supported GA count would apply; none was found. Generic Gemini architectural lineage does not supply a count. The independent approximately 3T black-box effective-capacity estimate is not substituted for a developer specification.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 active/activated-count search and later primary comparison checks found no numeric per-token active size. Original sparse MoE routing is qualitative, without expert dimensions or a routing fraction sufficient for a count. The identical GA model has no published active count either; benchmark scores, inference budgets and total-capacity estimates are not used as active parameters.

architecture.note: Explicitly described as sparse mixture-of-experts Transformers with native multimodal support. Normalize to moe; expert counts, dimensions and a decoder-only specification are not inferred.

context_window.note: The documented Gemini API input-token ceiling is 1,048,576. The separate 65,536-token output ceiling is not added to it. Historical indexed preview documentation is corroborated by the unchanged-GA bridge; no live endpoint invocation was performed.

modalities.note: Add video, which the baseline omitted. The dated preview supports PDF, image, text, audio and video input with text output. The separate Pro TTS endpoint and experimental native-audio variants do not confer audio output on this record.

reasoning.note: The June 5 release explicitly introduces adaptive thinking for this revision; the model card identifies reasoning before responding.

tool_call.note: Historical model documentation marks function calling supported, and the report defines tool use in terms of function calls. Confirmed for the revision, without transferring later tools such as File Search or Maps.

description.note: Replace generic promotional phrasing with the identified preview revision and documented capabilities.

patch.notes: This catalog key identifies the June 5, 2025 preview; the official API ID was gemini-2.5-pro-preview-06-05. Google promoted it unchanged to stable on June 17. Sparse MoE Transformer; neither total nor active parameter count is disclosed in the reviewed sources. The dated preview was shut down December 2, 2025. Earlier March and May revisions are distinct.

summary: Fresh October 27 parameter re-audit retains explicit null total and active counts after original-card/report checks, exact-ID searches and later first-party comparisons. The June preview-to-GA identity is valid, but neither has a published count. Google’s FMTI response adds no size, and independent black-box effective-capacity estimates are not nominal specifications. All unrelated field assessments and corrections are preserved.

evidence_checks.parameter_reaudit: October 27 fresh searches covered the exact API ID, Gemini 2.5 Pro nominal billions, active/activated parameters and named-base relationships. Reopened the June 17 unchanged-GA announcement and exact June 27 model card; inspected the fresh official Gemini 2.5 report and later Gemini 3 Pro/Flash, Argon card and Argon safety report. Followed the Google FMTI response and independent black-box capacity estimate. No accepted numerical disclosure emerged.
evidence_checks.parameter_lineage_review: The June preview and GA are explicitly identical. Their architectural relationship to Gemini 1.5/2.0 does not identify an unchanged count-bearing checkpoint. A nominal count would be acceptable without a tensor census, but no applicable published count was found.
